commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: The nearly 50-mile investigation is underway. There were shorter ways to spend the day, but none are currently under consideration.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: Six and a quarter miles are complete. A perfectly respectable walk has already occurred; the subject has declined to acknowledge this.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: Quarter distance: roughly twelve and a half miles. Officials confirm that this would have been an excellent place to stop.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: Nearly nineteen miles in and, yes, he is still walking. The field desk has exhausted its original list of questions.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: Halfway. The reward for walking twenty-five miles is the opportunity to walk approximately twenty-five more.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: The elevation desk reports almost two vertical kilometers gained in small, needlessly accumulated installments.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: Three quarters complete. At this distance, continuing forward is beginning to resemble a personality trait.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: Nearly forty-four miles are behind him. Oh my goodness, the walker is almost at the finish line—and he still is walking.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: The 50-mile walk is over. Nothing else needs to be walked today, although history suggests that message may not hold.
